Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 30. октобар ст. ст., „Св. ап. Клеопа, Терције, Марко, Јуст и Артем.“ — «Св. ап.» is "saint" plus the `apostle` grade this corpus keeps in `types`, and the four names after his are the other members the heading enumerates. attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: one of the Seventy, whom the page sends the reader to find at Luke 24.19–27. The page carries one notice for two men who have nothing to do with each other; the second, Joseph patriarch of Constantinople, is a new folder of this day's batch. saint.gr gives Cleopas no year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged, and prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.11.2025 (30. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. ап. Клеопа, Терције, Марко, Јуст и Артем.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, first of the five apostles it enumerates. THE HEADING ENUMERATES FIVE APOSTLES — «Клеопа, Терције, Марко, Јуст и Артем» — so the brief’s enumeration ruling makes it one folder per named member, and all five rows quote the whole heading. FOUR of the five take a row here. THE FIFTH, Марко, TAKES NOTHING: `mark-of-byblos` already carries a venerated serbian row out of this same book’s Julian 27 September, where it identifies him in the same words this entry does, and section 1 makes a saint already venerated on another day report-only. The reading is in the commit message. «ап.» is the `apostle` this folder holds, and the body’s «Од Седамдесеторице» — of the Seventy — is the same claim, so `types` is untouched. NO `dates`, AND THERE IS STILL NOTHING TO DATE HIM BY. This folder’s `dates` is null, and the Russian calendar’s «(I)» for the day’s apostles is not on it because the Russian row is `undocumented` here. THIS ENTRY GIVES HIM NO YEAR AND NO CENTURY EITHER — its whole sentence about him is that THE RISEN LORD APPEARED TO HIM ON THE ROAD TO EMMAUS. So no `dates` object was created, which is the brief’s rule exactly: if the page gives no year there is no `dates`. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: the Emmaus appearance, which is the whole of it, and which is also the whole of why he is remembered. The folder already relates `mary-of-cleopas`; this book does not mention her, so that row is untouched and unmentioned in the new paragraph. NO `related`, no `office`, no `locations` — Emmaus is a road in a Gospel narrative and not a coordinate. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Клеопа». This is also the folder’s FIRST Serbian form and its first row outside the Romanian and Greek calendars. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about king Milutin.
